docs: Separate signer that funds account rent. In self-paid transactions this
may be the player; sponsored transactions set it to the backend fee
payer without granting that payer authority over the player's tokens.

docs: The SPL token mint used for betting — any SPL token is accepted

accounts.name: chess_match
docs: The ChessMatch this pool tracks. Must have prediction_enabled = true.

accounts.name: prediction_pool
docs: PredictionPool PDA — one per match.

accounts.name: prediction_pool_vault
docs: Vault token account that holds all spectator bets. Owned by the prediction pool PDA.

accounts.name: betting_token_mint
docs: The SPL token mint used for betting (same as the chess match).

accounts.name: chess_match
docs: The ChessMatch — read-only, used for constraints.

accounts.name: prediction_pool
docs: The PredictionPool tracking accumulated bets.

accounts.name: prediction_bet
docs: PDA per bettor — created once per bettor per pool.

accounts.name: prediction_pool_vault
docs: Vault token account that receives all spectator bets.

accounts.name: bettor_token_account
docs: The bettor's token account (source of bet funds).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Rent destination for escrow account closure — receives lamports back.

accounts.name: player
docs: Must be one of the two players — determines which color's session is set.

accounts.name: prediction_pool_vault
docs: Vault holding all spectator bets. PDA-owned by prediction_pool.

accounts.name: match_winner_ata
docs: Match winner's ATA. In a draw, this is the White player's ATA.

accounts.name: match_loser_ata
docs: Match loser's ATA. In a draw, this is the Black player's ATA.

accounts.name: platform_fee_ata
docs: Platform fee ATA. Must be owned by the platform_fee_wallet from ChessMatch.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — fee payer triggers settlement.

errors.name: InvalidOwner
errors.msg: The provided token account is not owned by the player.

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: The provided token account's mint does not match the betting token mint.

errors.name: InvalidBetAmount
errors.msg: The bet amount is invalid.

errors.name: MatchAlreadyFull
errors.msg: The match is already full.

errors.name: InvalidMatchIdLength
errors.msg: Match ID length is invalid or exceeds maximum allowed.

errors.name: InvalidPublicKeyString
errors.msg: Invalid public key string format during parsing.

errors.name: InvalidPlatformFee
errors.msg: Platform fee basis points exceed maximum (10000).

errors.name: UnsupportedBettingToken
errors.msg: Unsupported betting token mint. Only SEND or wSOL allowed.

errors.name: InvalidMoveOutOfBounds
errors.msg: Invalid move: Coordinates out of bounds.

errors.name: InvalidMoveEmptySource
errors.msg: Invalid move: Source square is empty.

errors.name: InvalidMoveNotYourPiece
errors.msg: Invalid move: Not your piece to move.

errors.name: InvalidMoveCannotCaptureOwnPiece
errors.msg: Invalid move: Cannot capture your own piece.

errors.name: InvalidMoveIllegalPieceMovement
errors.msg: Invalid move: Illegal movement for this piece type.

errors.name: InvalidMoveLeavesKingInCheck
errors.msg: Invalid move: Move leaves king in check.

errors.name: InvalidPromotionPiece
errors.msg: Invalid promotion: Specified piece type is not allowed for promotion.

errors.name: InvalidPromotionNotOnLastRank
errors.msg: Invalid promotion: Pawn is not on the last rank for promotion.

errors.name: InvalidPromotionNotAPawn
errors.msg: Invalid promotion: Only pawns can be promoted.

errors.name: KingNotFound
errors.msg: Internal error: King not found on the board.

errors.name: InvalidMatchId
errors.msg: Invalid Match ID provided.

errors.name: AlreadyJoined
errors.msg: You are already joined this match.

errors.name: InvalidEscrowAccount
errors.msg: Invalid escrow account authority.

errors.name: MathError
errors.msg: Arithmetic operation overflow/underflow.

errors.name: GameNotActive
errors.msg: The game is not currently active.

errors.name: NotAPlayer
errors.msg: The signer is not a registered player in this match.

errors.name: NotYourTurn
errors.msg: It is not the signer's turn to move.

errors.name: PlayerTimedOut
errors.msg: Player has timed out.

errors.name: MatchAlreadyFullOrActive
errors.msg: Match is already full or active, cannot join.

errors.name: InvalidMintForJoin
errors.msg: The mint of your token account does not match the established betting token for this match.

errors.name: CannotJoinOwnMatch
errors.msg: Player cannot join their own match as the second player.

errors.name: BetAmountMismatch
errors.msg: Joining bet amount does not match the creator's bet amount.

errors.name: OpponentNotJoinedYet
errors.msg: Opponent has not joined the match yet, cannot determine winner by resignation.

errors.name: NotOpponentsTurnToClaimTimeout
errors.msg: It is not the opponent's turn, so you cannot claim a timeout win yet.

errors.name: TimeoutNotConfigured
errors.msg: Move timeout is not configured for this match.

errors.name: OpponentNotTimedOut
errors.msg: Opponent has not actually timed out yet.

errors.name: GameNotConcluded
errors.msg: The game has not yet concluded.

errors.name: PayoutAlreadyProcessed
errors.msg: Payout for this match has already been processed.

errors.name: PlayerTokenAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Player token account mismatch for payout.

errors.name: PlatformTokenAccountError
errors.msg: Platform fee token account mismatch or invalid mint for payout.

errors.name: InvalidPlatformFeeWallet
errors.msg: Platform fee wallet does not match the expected recipient.

errors.name: DuplicateAccounts
errors.msg: Duplicate mutable accounts detected — state corruption risk.

errors.name: InvalidGameStateForPayout
errors.msg: Game state is invalid for processing a payout (e.g., winner does not exist).

errors.name: UnauthorizedSigner
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized — must be the player whose turn it is or a valid session key.

errors.name: InvalidSession
errors.msg: Session key is expired or invalid for this action.

errors.name: MatchNotWaitingForOpponent
errors.msg: Match is not in WaitingForOpponent state, cannot abort.

errors.name: NotMatchCreator
errors.msg: Only the match creator can perform this action.

errors.name: MatchNotSettled
errors.msg: Match settlement has not been processed yet, cannot close.

errors.name: PredictionNotEnabled
errors.msg: Prediction market is not enabled for this match.

errors.name: PredictionPoolAlreadyExists
errors.msg: A prediction pool already exists for this match.

errors.name: PredictionPoolNotFound
errors.msg: Prediction pool not found for this match.

errors.name: PlayersCannotBet
errors.msg: Players in the match cannot place prediction bets.

errors.name: BettingClosed
errors.msg: Betting is closed — the match is no longer Active.

errors.name: InvalidOutcome
errors.msg: Invalid outcome — must be 0 (White), 1 (Black), or 2 (Draw).

errors.name: SettlementAlreadyProcessed
errors.msg: Prediction settlement has already been processed for this pool.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Winnings have already been claimed for this bet.

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: Nothing to claim — no balance available for this bet.

errors.name: MatchNotAborted
errors.msg: The match has not been aborted, cannot cancel this way.

errors.name: CannotCancelActiveMatch
errors.msg: Cannot cancel bet on an Active match.

errors.name: InvalidTimeoutDuration
errors.msg: Move timeout duration must be non-negative.

types.name: PredictionBet
docs: One bettor's prediction on a match.
Pull-model: payout is claimed individually via claim_prediction_winnings.

types.name: PredictionPool
docs: Pools all prediction bets for a single chess match.
Parimutuel model — winners split the losing pool proportionally.
